name: Nature Nate's 100% Pure Raw & Unfiltered Clover Honey
whyItWorks: Unadulterated honey retaining beneficial bee enzymes and antimicrobial propolis. While high in natural fructose (caution in severe fructose malabsorption), 1 teaspoon provides clean, soothing energy in warm herbal teas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir 1 level teaspoon into warm (not boiling) chamomile or ginger tea. In active severe diarrhea, pure maple syrup is lower in fructose and slightly gentler.
